$comment: Precise-edge exemptions for scripts/ci/checkHostDeviceBoundaries.mjs (v2, WD-06/FIX-E). Each entry owns exactly one edge: {rule, importer, target, scope, owner, reason, exit, expires?}. `importer` is a repo-relative path or precise glob; `target` is the resolved target string the gate emits (builtin:<name>, pkg:<name>, file:<repo-path>, unresolved:<spec>). `scope`: direct = edge judged on the importer's own source; closure = edge judged inside the web entry closure. `isdesktop-census` entries use importer+max (a shrinking usage cap — regressions fail). A NEW importer hitting an exempted target FAILS. An allowlisted edge that vanishes is STALE and FAILS — delete the entry with the debt.
